text: Novo Nordisk A/S's unlisted A shares are held by Novo Holdings A/S, a Danish public limited liability company wholly owned by the Novo Nordisk Foundation; each A share carries 100 votes, giving the Foundation-controlled Novo Holdings the controlling vote.
short: Novo Holdings, owned by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, holds Novo Nordisk's A shares.
